title: Matrix lookup, item price and convert/round (guide fig. 3)
summary: Drill-down of "Price-list matrix role": the shared control-template -> matrix-row lookup applied to price lists, then item price, unit conversion and rounding. Mapped from field guide inputs/dsp-price-calculation.html (sha256:d260ad4216e3); every node is tagged confirmed / design-only / conflicting / code-only against code. Conceptual stages, decisions and data transformations only; not a call stack or observed runtime behaviour.

sources.note: Line 28: control row = CROBJC copy with ProgramName OIS831 and StartValue1 = price-list table.
Lines 7-25: price-list templates PC01..PC91 -> priorities 1..10 (5 fields each); lines 27-45: discount templates PC11..PC91 -> 1..9, PC01 -> 10.
Lines 29-88: per priority: direct match, then chain levels 9->1 with wildcard variants; best QueryOrder then MostSpecificPriority, one list per priority.

Lines 114-168 and 181-206: OPRICL row by list + customer, then chain, then list only (same currency, valid date); latest ValidFrom per limit/campaign; unit conversion; rounding; standard (limit 0, no campaign) vs campaign/limit prices.

M3 Price calculation analysis: PRMS strategies (301/303/E02/E03/E08 = 6C21; 302/E01 = 621; observed X 9 6 C 2 1), agreement strategy 6 (OAGRHE valid-from asc -> OAGSET -> OAGRLN/OAGRPR, first price stops), strategy 2 (CROBJC -> price lists, OGDIPO <= 8 positions, OGDMTX, best price), NOTE2 OIS320MI PRMS overridden to 2, control matrix 10 priorities (CROBJC PC01..PC91 from 0), convert/round via MITAUN/CSYPAR/CSYTAB, cut-off to M3 to be found.

uncertainties: dsp-price copy has no .git; evidence identified by per-file sha256.
The field guide is a secondary summary (draw.io figures were unreadable to its author); Confluence pages and code are the cited evidence.
The same lookup shape serves discounts (layer:price.api.get-prices.calculator.discount). Agreement lookup (OAGSET -> OAGRLN/OAGRPR) is design-only: no resolver in code.
Price-group lookup (CROBJC OIS366 -> OSLTPG) is not modelled in DSP code; not drawn.
Guide: older M3 versions may have only 3 template fields per priority; code assumes 5.
New nested layer id: auto-layout on first open; no dsp-arch-pos carryover; existing parent ids/positions unchanged.

nodes.label: Matrix row search per priority (OPRMTX)
nodes.responsibility: Guide vs code: confirmed. For each configured priority: matrix rows tagged with that priority (PREX) must match the values; the first (most specific) match is kept, giving one price list per priority position. Code adds: direct match first, then customer chain levels 9 -> 1 with wildcard variants.
